name: mic
prompt: A dedicated microphone button asset for a children's English story roleplay game. Round coral pink button, ivory microphone icon centered, thin mint rim and warm cream edge, polished soft 2D storybook shading, restrained depth, clean readable simple icon, no text, no letters, no people. Transparent outside button. Consistent with warm ivory/coral/mint story classroom UI.

name: role-badge
prompt: A dedicated wide horizontal role badge for children's story acting game, aspect 3:1. Warm ivory enamel center completely blank for live role name text. Thin teal outline, coral ribbon ends and small theatre curtain folds at far left and right edges only. Clean soft 2D illustrated storybook style, restrained depth, generous blank flat center. No text, letters, people or faces. Transparent exterior.

name: film-frame
prompt: A dedicated children's story sequencing picture-card FRAME. Landscape 3:2. Very THIN warm ivory rounded frame with restrained coral edge and tiny teal corner tabs, no bulky decorations. Center window FULLY TRANSPARENT, covers 90% of image to show large story picture. Cute clean illustrated 2D storybook finish. Transparent exterior AND transparent central opening. No text, no words, no picture, no background.

name: check-badge
prompt: A dedicated reward badge for a children's story sequencing game: soft mint green scalloped medallion, warm ivory center with one large teal check mark, tiny coral ribbon tails. Clean polished 2D storybook illustration, warm matte shading, no glitter, no text or letters. Transparent background.

name: story-listen-button
prompt: Create one dedicated illustrated button asset for a preschool English story game. Wide horizontal 3.5:1 rounded rectangle. Warm ivory flat BLANK center/right for live text, mint teal raised rim with a restrained coral edge. At FAR LEFT ONLY a clear cute open storybook with a small white speaker/sound-wave emblem, both fitted within left 22% of width. Keep right 72% completely blank and light ivory for text readability. Soft polished 2D storybook shading, crisp clean edges, warm matte material, not glossy plastic. Transparent exterior. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers. Single button only.
